description.zh:
导播台ID。

- 如果您通过[CreateCaster接口](~~2848009~~)创建导播台，请查看CreateCaster接口调用返回的参数CasterId值。

- 如果您通过直播控制台创建导播台，请通过**直播控制台** > **导播台** > **云导播台**路径查看导播台名称。

> 直播控制台云导播台页面导播台列表中的导播台名称即导播台ID。


导播台需满足如下配置：
- **NormType**：**3**。您需要提前创建好轻量级轮播型的导播台，可以调用**CreateCaster**接口创建导播台。
- **CasterTemplate**：lp_noTranscode。
- **channelEnable**：0。
- **programEffect**：1。
description.en:
The ID of the production studio.

- If you create a production studio by calling the [CreateCaster](~~2848009~~) operation, use the value of the CasterId parameter that is returned.

- If you create a production studio in the ApsaraVideo Live console, go to **ApsaraVideo Live console** > **Production Studio** > **Cloud Production Studio** to view the name of the production studio.

> The name of the production studio in the list on the Cloud Production Studio page is the ID of the production studio.

The production studio must have the following configurations:

- **NormType**: **3**. You must create a lightweight carousel production studio. You can call the **CreateCaster** operation to create the studio.

- **CasterTemplate**: lp\_noTranscode.

- **channelEnable**: 0.

- **programEffect**: 1.

description.zh: 节目单项配置。若首次添加，传该参数进行初始化配置。更多信息，请参见**ProgramConfig**。
description.en: The playlist item configurations. If this is the first time you add items, pass this parameter for initialization. For more information, see **ProgramConfig**.

description.zh: 节目单ID。不填则默认创建一个新的节目单。
description.en: The playlist ID. If you leave this parameter empty, a new playlist is created.

description.zh: 节目单项输入列表。为JSON字符串，更多信息，请参见**InputProgramItem**。
description.en: The list of playlist items. This is a JSON string. For more information, see **InputProgramItem**.

descriptions.zh:
先创建导播台，添加导播台布局和导播台组件，再调用本接口添加节目单项。若没有创建过节目单，则直接创建。使用API创建导播台请参考[创建导播台](~~2848009~~)。

## QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为10次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
After you create a production studio with a layout and components, you can call this operation to add items to a playlist. If a playlist does not exist, a new one is created. For more information about how to create a production studio by calling an API operation, see [Create a production studio](~~2848009~~).

## QPS limit

The queries per second (QPS) limit for this operation is 10 calls per second for each user. If you exceed the limit, API calls are throttled. This may impact your business. We recommend that you call this operation at a reasonable rate.
